I told Marcus in a thread reply on his #north-team message that no new renewal date has been agreed for Brackenwater Freight Co.

- **The date to use:** 30 November 2026. That's the end of the current term in the signed 2025–2026 renewal order form (signed 21 Nov 2025), and the Brackenwater account page says the same.
- **The open question:** on 14 Oct Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. I asked her in that thread whether it's a changed date or just an internal deadline, and she hasn't replied.
- **No amendment:** I couldn't find any document that moves the date to 25 November, although the search I ran only matches exact words, so it could have missed one.

I suggested he put 30 November in the account sheet for now and check with Ilse about 25 November. My reply gave dates only, no money terms, so it was fine to post in the channel.
